subject: Congratulations!
text:
Hi [NAME],

Just saw you closed the Series A round - massive congrats! I read that
you're doubling down on your video AI agent - thought it might be a good
time to connect.

Bit of context on Encord: We work with Milestone Systems, LiveView
Technologies, Flock Safety, Rhombus, etc. to improve the quality of video
surveillance models. We help by consolidating video data curation,
annotation and model evaluation into one platform, with the objective of
accelerating speed to market with new AI security products.

Our leadership would love to chat about how you're scaling your MLOp post
Series A - We're at ISC West Wednesday (4/2) to Friday (4/4) next week if
you're open for a coffee at the conference?Alternatively, If virtual works
better can work around your schedule!

subject: Working with Invisible AI, DDD, Cloudfactory & others
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Noticed that you Sigma AI has a very large pool of expert annotators (25k+) & was curious to understand how you're thinking about handling the shift towards Multimodal / Physical AI annotations? 

We've recently started working with Invisible AI, Digital Divide Data & Cloudfactory as their existing annotation tools (both internal & third party) were unable to keep pace with rising client demands for more sophisticated multimodal annotations. 

At Encord we've built a multimodal data development platform, bringing together annotation of Videos, Images, Documents, Audio, and Point Cloud data in a single platform - enabling annotation teams to deliver more complex projects for their customers, faster. 

Curious to hear how you're thinking about future proofing your annotation platform - let me know if you're open to having a chat,

subject: MSA with Mayo Clinic | Medical segmentation & QA workflows
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We recently finalised an MSA with Mayo from working with one of your Computer Vision teams (led by Simon Laplante). Given that the legal framework is already in place, thought it might make sense to explore if we can help other teams. 

We're also working with other Enterprise Healthcare AI/ML teams including Siemens Healthineers, Mars, & Bayer - who all came to Encord looking to move away from basic open source annotation tools, which lacked scalability & the traceability required for FDA approval. 

At Encord, we've developed an Enterprise-grade platform for medical segmentations & QA workflows, so AI teams can accelerate the production of high-quality training data whilst maintaining compliance with data security & regulatory standards.

Would be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've been building with our Healthcare partners, including Simon's team. 

Open to learning more?

subject: Chatted to Shiraj Sen
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently spoke to Shiraj Sen, who highlighted some key challenges with the rules-driven approach to data curation taken today at [COMPANY], so thought it might make sense to reach out & introduce Encord.

Many of the leading AV perception teams we work with (Woven, Wayve, Oxa) initially faced challenges with existing internal curation tools lacking the speed & scalability required to efficiently visualise and surface edge cases from their large (100s of millions) multimodal training datasets.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support searching through billions of multimodal data items in an intuitive front-end (across Video, Audio, LiDAR, Radar), enabling AV teams to avoid error-prone rule-based approaches & reduce false positive rates.

Curious to explore how we can help the [COMPANY] team - let me know if you have any questions,
